title: Family origins, mother's piano and brother Joe
summary: Roy gives his birth date and parents' origins, says he was the youngest of twelve, and credits his mother's piano playing and toy drums for his ear; Joe studied violin, harmony and arranging.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Roy Eldridge (6/15/82 & 6/22/83): These dates are correct
Now, Roy, you were born in Pittsburgh in 1911, January 31st?
January 30, 1911. Did your family always live in Pittsburgh? Or did your parents come from others parts of the country?

Well, no. My father came from North Carolina. Actually, he was born in Virginia, but I can't think of the name of the town. Not Alexandria, somewhere else. Petersburg, I think it was. And my mother was born in North Carolina, you know. But he was raised in North Carolina, my father, I would say, yeah. But me, I was born in Pittsburgh! -- heh-heh.
And you had an older brother.
Yeah, I had a brother. Two brothers and a sister. And I think there were... So I understand, there was twelve of us, and I'm the last of the crop!
Now, I know that your brother Joe was musical. Was there anybody else who played in the family?
My mother played piano. I think that's where I got mine from, was her. Because when I was little, around five or six years old, I got a set of drums, of toy drums

for Christmas. And we used to go to the theatre, and in the theatre they always had the piano player that used to play for the movies, and she would come home and play these things that she'd heard. She wouldn't need no music or nothing, because she could them, you know. And I would play the drums with her, you know. So I think that's where the ear comes from, you know, being able to hear things.

Of course, Joe was a different thing. He went and studied violin, and he studied harmony and arranging, and saxophone, you know. So it was a different story with him. Plus, I never had too much eyes for being a musician in the first place!
